name: Ea
basis: (E) estimate tail_sum4: (b-a)/2 times the sum of the last four Chebyshev coefficients of the fine interpolant. It does NOT qualify as an estimate by section 2.3's rule: on D2's sample its ratio to CC_47's true error has minimum 0.20 on the gate leaves (0.199 window, 0.228-0.493 gate group, 0.401 gate analytic) and 0.081 over the 22,876 measured chase leaves (out/d2/d2_table.md, out/d2/d2_regimes.json); it is the candidate closest to a bound (pair 0.020, nest3 0.004, tail_max4x2 0.118). Run, flagged, so that the tables show what a sharper estimate does; no constant is set: the estimate is used as it is. Scope: every Clenshaw-Curtis solve, window pieces included.
